name: @rello-platform/precedence-authority
description: Pure-function precedence-authority comparator for the Rello nurture stack — evaluatePrecedence() decides whether a goal-shift-bearing signal preempts an active campaign for a lead. Single source of truth for the 13-arm outcome cascade (lock-tier exemptions, signal-quality gates, goal comparison) consumed by Rello's signal-driven enrollEligibleCampaigns connector.
